product_family: SEO content optimization and monitoring platform. Core features: content brief builder (research & outline generation), content optimization (real-time SEO scoring), and content monitoring (rank tracking, automated alerts). No explicit sub-products; single-tier SaaS.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence; not applicable for consumer/SMB SEO tool

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service state 'Due to the nature of machine learning, Output may not be unique across users' indicating output is non-exclusive. Vendor does not explicitly confirm whether customer content or generated outputs are used to train their AI models. This ambiguity is a flag for users concerned about data reuse.

products.name: Dashword
products.data_scope: Customer marketing content (blog posts, web pages), SEO keywords, competitor data, company metadata (name, email, phone during registration)
products.notes: Single product. Processes customer content for SEO analysis and ranking insights. No explicit data residency offered. No separate compliance tiers (consumer vs. enterprise).

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (free trial, tiered plans based on features/usage; pricing not detailed in public evidence)

flags: No trust center or dedicated security page on vendor domain
No industry-standard security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) published or claimed
AI training ambiguity: ToS states outputs 'may not be unique across users' but does not explicitly confirm whether customer content is used to train models
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) offered despite handling customer marketing data
Data residency/location not disclosed; vendor does not specify where customer data is stored
Security infrastructure details absent from public documentation: no encryption standards, no breach notification process, no third-party audit evidence
GDPR compliance claimed but limited infrastructure evidence to support it
Liability cap in ToS: 'limited to amount paid; no consequential or punitive damages'
Legal entity is Estonian (Dashword OÜ); data storage location unclear
